name: tyrian-night
description: Ultra-saturated Tyrian Abyss, Night, Nocturne, Night Old comparison, and Dawn themes with built-in Island UI controls

scripts.verify: bun run check:tracked-generated && bun run build:generated && bun run check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run format:check && bun run check:generated && bun run check:union-css && bun run check:rice
scripts.precommit:tracked-generated: git ls-files --error-unmatch source/themeRoleContract.json scripts/themeDefinition.mjs scripts/projections/vscodeColors.json scripts/vscodeThemes.mjs apps/vscode/src/generated/themeCatalog.ts apps/vscode/themes/tyrian-night.json apps/vscode/themes/tyrian-nocturne.json apps/vscode/themes/tyrian-night-old.json apps/vscode/themes/tyrian-abyss.json apps/vscode/themes/tyrian-dawn.json apps/zed/themes/tyrian-night.json && git diff --quiet -- source/themeCatalog.json source/themeRoleContract.json source/themes scripts/themeDefinition.mjs scripts/projections/vscodeColors.json scripts/vscodeThemes.mjs package.json apps/vscode/src/generated/themeCatalog.ts apps/vscode/themes apps/zed/themes/tyrian-night.json
scripts.package:check: bun run verify && bun run build
scripts.build:generated: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:vscode-themes && bun run build:island-css && bun run build:zed-theme && bun run build:terminal-themes && bun run build:desktop-themes
scripts.build:runtime-generated: bun run build:island-css && bun run build:terminal-themes && bun run build:desktop-themes
scripts.check:tracked-generated: bun run check:contracts && bun run check:vscode-themes && bun run check:zed-theme
scripts.check:generated: bun run check:contracts && bun run check:vscode-themes && bun run check:island-css && bun run check:zed-theme && bun run check:terminal-themes && bun run check:desktop-themes
scripts.package: bun run package:check && mkdir -p dist && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/tyrian-night.vsix

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bun run precommit:tracked-generated && bun run verify
